pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 我 (wǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hello
   B. I, me
   C. Goodbye
   D. Teacher

2. Which initial is said WITHOUT a puff of air? (1 mark)
   A. t
   B. d
   C. k
   D. p

3. Which sentence is a correct answer to 这是谁? (1 mark)
   A. 我在家。
   B. 电视在哪儿?
   C. 这是什么?
   D. 这是我妈妈。

4. Which sentence is in the right order for "We cut the cake"? (1 mark)
   A. 我们切蛋糕。
   B. 蛋糕我们切。
   C. 切我们蛋糕。
   D. 蛋糕切我们。

5. What does 茶 (chá) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Dinner
   B. Beef
   C. Flat bread
   D. Tea

6. What should you do if you make a mistake while presenting? (1 mark)
   A. Stay calm, breathe and say it again
   B. Stop and cry
   C. Run away
   D. Blame a friend

7. What does 朋友 (péngyou) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Friend
   B. To wish
   C. Month
   D. Date (day of the month)

8. Read the pinyin: wǒ hē chá. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is a banana.
   B. I drink tea.
   C. For breakfast I eat bǐng.
   D. I like to eat bananas.

9. What does 摸 (mō) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To cry
   B. To touch
   C. To brush teeth
   D. To laugh, to smile

10. What does 盘子 (pánzi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Plate
   B. Gift
   C. Knife
   D. Birthday

11. What does 喜欢 (xǐhuan) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Apple
   B. Meat
   C. Dinner
   D. To like

12. Fill the blank: 我用耳朵____。 (I use my ears to hear.) (1 mark)
   A. 说
   B. 吃
   C. 看
   D. 听

13. Which Chinese word means "thank you"? (1 mark)
   A. 我 wǒ
   B. 你好 nǐ hǎo
   C. 叫 jiào
   D. 谢谢 xièxie

14. What does 洪水 (hóngshuǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Also
   B. Very
   C. Flood
   D. Not

15. What does 牛奶 (niúnǎi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Vegetables
   B. Spinach
   C. Milk
   D. Meat

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write the first two strokes of 右 and the first two strokes of 左. (3 marks)

17. Write three things you could include in a class display and one thing to check. (3 marks)

18. Give two words with the final -ao and one with the final -ang, with pinyin. (3 marks)

19. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my mouth to speak." (2 marks)

20. Explain the difference between skimming and scanning. (2 marks)

21. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I love you." (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — I, me
   我 (wǒ) means I, me.

2. B — d
   d is unaspirated. t, k and p are said with a puff of air.

3. D — 这是我妈妈。
   谁 asks who, and the answer names a person.

4. A — 我们切蛋糕。
   The order is who, action, thing.

5. D — Tea
   茶 (chá) means tea.

6. A — Stay calm, breathe and say it again
   Everyone makes mistakes.

7. A — Friend
   朋友 (péngyou) means friend.

8. B — I drink tea.
   wǒ hē chá. is 我喝茶。, which means "I drink tea.".

9. B — To touch
   摸 (mō) means to touch.

10. A — Plate
   盘子 (pánzi) means plate.

11. D — To like
   喜欢 (xǐhuan) means to like.

12. D — 听
   听 is to hear.

13. D — 谢谢 xièxie
   谢谢 (xièxie) means thank you.

14. C — Flood
   洪水 (hóngshuǐ) means flood.

15. C — Milk
   牛奶 (niúnǎi) means milk.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: 右: 撇 then 横. 左: 横 then 撇.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct stroke pair and 1 mark for the difference.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example a labelled house plan, a birthday card and character models; check tone marks and stroke order.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each item and 1 mark for a check.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example 好 hǎo, 小 xiǎo; 房 fáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我用嘴巴说。 wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Skimming is reading quickly to get the main idea. Scanning is looking for one particular word or fact.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我爱你。 wǒ ài nǐ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.
